cases.title: Predict alloy phases
cases.mechanism: A fidelity kernel offers a different similarity geometry for small materials datasets.
cases.scope: 10-qubit replay, 10 splits. Stronger tuned classical models lead in follow-up comparisons.

cases.title: Recover a wireless signal
cases.mechanism: A fixed quantum reservoir supplies nonlinear temporal features for a classical readout.
cases.scope: 6 qubits, 3 fresh simulated datasets at 20 dB. Stronger causal classical controls lead.

cases.title: Classify satellite images
cases.mechanism: A compact hybrid image head combines learned encoding with a reconstruction objective.
cases.scope: Simplified simulator benchmark; large CNNs were reference comparisons under lightweight training settings.

cases.title: Screen a molecular endpoint
cases.mechanism: Annealer-based selection tests a regularized ensemble of weak learners.
cases.scope: The positive endpoint is one of ten ADMET datasets; LightAutoML leads on the other nine.

cases.title: Spend fewer training epochs
cases.mechanism: A quantum-trained learning-curve predictor helps prioritize neural-network trials.
cases.scope: Epoch counts exclude end-to-end annealer overhead; gains over classical prediction are task dependent and aggregation is a confound.

cases.title: Match ambiguous records
cases.mechanism: TF-IDF handles easy pairs; a jointly trained hybrid head handles an ambiguous region.
cases.scope: The win is for the combined pipeline on an extended hard-case test; standalone HQNN scores 0.887 there and Osaka hardware evaluation is lower.

cases.title: Choose a multiclass kernel
cases.baseline: Tested linear, polynomial, sigmoid and Gaussian SVMs
cases.mechanism: Select a task-dependent fidelity geometry and fit a classical one-vs-rest classifier.
cases.scope: Figure-only paired comparisons are not transcribed as exact numbers; the Pauli product kernels also have an efficient exact classical formula.

cases.title: Study attack transfer
cases.mechanism: A different learned representation can resist perturbations from a classical surrogate.
cases.scope: A transfer-attack benefit is distinct from white-box robustness: attacks optimized directly against QVCs remain effective.
